utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I may be a bit forgetful, but I’m happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll let you know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best. If I forget, feel free to remind me!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not much yet — we’re just getting folks lined up for the repair drive. I’ll repeat the plan to everyone once we’ve got the details set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks for looping me in. Just let me know when the details are set and I’ll try not to miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Uli? Do you need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going, thanks for asking. I could use help sorting a few things, if you’ve got a moment.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what do you want me to sort first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive. If you want, I can swing by and help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Quinn — thank you. I’m keeping track of who’s covering which streets, so your help would really keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll start with my street and check in on the next two blocks too. If you want, I can bring a quick list back so you can mark it off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you handle sorting the donated tools and labeling the boxes by type? If that’s okay, I’ll check the list and confirm the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes by type. Let me know the drop-off details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few extra gloves?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll spread the word and point folks your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep a clear list ready so anyone can jump in where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—what time are we starting, and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll start at 9 a.m. by the community shed, and folks can drop items off there until noon. I’ll put up a clear sign so nobody has to guess.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—thank you. I’ll tell people to aim for the shed by 9 and to get their drop-offs in before noon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely. I’ll swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces. If you spot anything still needed, let me know and I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check what’s left and let you know if anything needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got a few spare tools and some tape set aside for the repair drive. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, you really still have some tape and tools set aside?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, I do — not a ton, but enough to help out. If you tell me what you need, I can check what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and some tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Gus—thanks! We could really use your tools first, then I’ll round up a few more folks to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring over my toolbox and a few extras. Just tell me where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I can check our school pickup timing and see when we can swing by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks — just let me know what time works and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll confirm after I check pickup, then I’ll send you a time that works for us.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be amazing, Faye — thank you. I’ll line up the repair tasks around those times and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send them over when you have them and I’ll plan around the pickup window. Happy to help make it fit the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — let me just double-check the details first, and I’ll confirm with you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — can you let me know as soon as you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — everyone’s just pulling things together now. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks for confirming — what time should I plan to be there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’m putting the repair drive details in order now—what do you want to help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies and make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Cleo—thank you. I’ll start the supply list, and you can keep an eye on what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it simple today. If you tell me what’s most needed, I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — the biggest help is tools and a few spare hands. If you can just bring what you have, that’ll be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a basic toolbox and show up for a few hours. Just let me know when and where to be.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive got a pretty good turnout, but I’m only going off what people told me. Did they end up fixing the fence by the corner?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure, honestly—I kept meaning to check and then got distracted. I think they were still working on it when I left, but I’d ask someone closer to the fence.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Ah, got it—thanks. I’ll ask around and see if anyone knows whether they finished it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, it’s just folks pitching in with fixes around the neighborhood — I think there was talk of tools, maybe a sign-up sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can probably help if there’s a simple fix. Where do I sign up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — first we should sort the donated items and set aside anything that needs tools or spare parts. After that, we can make a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll start sorting the donated items and pull out anything that needs tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Count me in, Gus — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. I’ll round up the tools and be ready when folks start showing up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll let folks know to swing by and bring a few extra hands if they can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — I just need help sorting the repair-drive drop-off spot and keeping track of what goes where.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort the drop-off spot and keep track of the items.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you looking out — I’ll let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — just wave me down if anything changes.
